biocontainers.name: bioconductor-cordon
biocontainers.summary: Codon usage analysis and prediction of gene expressivity

biotools.summary: Tool for analysis of codon usage in various unannotated or KEGG/COG annotated DNA sequences. Calculates different measures of CU bias and CU-based predictors of gene expressivity, and performs gene set enrichment analysis for annotated sequences. Implements several methods for visualization of CU and enrichment analysis results.
